notes.title: v1.5.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.5.1 Update Notes September 8, 2025

This update fixes two long-standing bugs.

Fix: After putting on the red pumps, the game keeps showing a loading screen and fails to enter the room scene.
Fix: The scene might appear whitish after entering a level.

notes.title: v1.5.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.5.0 Update Notes September 7, 2025

This update aims to address three issues:

Prolonged battles where zombies chase players for an excessively long time.
Over-reliance on summons (e.g., aircraft, lightning) to finish off low-health zombies.
Over-reliance on summons (e.g., aircraft, lightning) to defeat bosses; the goal is to encourage more direct player engagement with bosses.


To this end, the following adjustments have been made:

Reduced the health of zombies and bosses.
When an airdrop effect (bullet time, shield, freeze) is activated, bosses will be prioritized as targets.
Changed the objective of regular levels to eliminating a specific number of zombies.


Sandra

Assault Rifle: Prioritizes attacking zombies within close range (approximately 35% of its maximum range) to ensure safety, followed by bosses, and then targets with the lowest health.
Grenade: Thrown accurately and predictively at areas where zombies are concentrated.
Drone: Replaced with a modern drone that follows Sandra and attacks the same targets she engages.


Maeve

Shotgun: Adjusted to match Sandra’s (assault rifle targeting logic).


Annie

Stun gun: Adjusted to match Sandra’s (assault rifle targeting logic).
Lightning Strike: Reduced cooldown time, with a corresponding decrease in damage. Prioritizes attacking bosses within the player’s attack range and zombies with the highest health.
Electrostatic Field: Significantly reduced cooldown time and increased damage.


Hilda

Crossbow: Adjusted to match Sandra’s (assault rifle targeting logic).
Molotov Cocktail: Significantly increased damage (previously excessively low damage was a bug); other adjustments match Sandra’s Grenade (accurate, predictive throws at zombie clusters).
Frisbee: Reduced the angle range of the frisbee’s trajectory to prevent missing zombies.


Rose

Grenade Launcher: Always targets areas within range where zombies are concentrated.
Machine Gun post: Slightly reduced the range at Level 5 and decreased damage.


Other Updates

Optimization: Improved the explosion effect when zombies are killed.
Adjustment: The Boss (Giant Hammer) is now selectable as a target during its charge and buffer phases (previously unselectable).
Adjustment: The talent "Skip Skill Selection" has been replaced with "Airdrop Enhancement", which increases airdrop effects by up to 30%.
Adjustment: The Boss (Juggernaut)’s damage ignores damage reduction effects, and its horizontal rotation speed during attacks has been increased.
Fix: Resolved the issue where zombies outside the map area would move toward the player after the freeze airdrop item takes effect.
Fix: Resolved the issue where joystick controls would stop functioning after exhausting the number of uses when clicking the random button via the joystick while selecting upgrade options.
Other minor optimizations.

notes.title: v1.3.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.3.0 Update Notes August 9, 2025


The specific contents of the update are as follows:

Adjustment: During non-combat time, the girls will now be in their own rooms, whereas they were previously on the rooftop of the building. The experience of interacting with the girls has been improved, allowing them to strike unlocked poses. Due to the limited space in the rooms, another scene will be switched to when displaying actions and poses.
Adjustment: The main interface and the girls' information interface have been integrated.
Adjustment: The UI style has been changed to feature orange as the main color, replacing the previous blue.
Optimization: The number of objectives for zombie elimination and mutant serum collection tasks has been significantly reduced.
Optimization: Equipment descriptions have been optimized to directly state the equipment effects.
Fix: The issue where the talent interface did not locate the currently unlockable talent after being opened has been fixed.

notes.title: v1.2.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.2.0 Update Notes July 24, 2025

The specific contents of the update are as follows:

Optimization: Updated the photo albums, replacing some old photos. Each girl now has 21 photos.
Adjustment: Photo albums are no longer obtained as achievement rewards; they have been moved to level rewards.
Adjustment: Now ordinary zombies will also drop costume styles. The portion that should be obtained will be compensated according to the number of zombies killed.
Fix: The proportion of photo prints on the ground during battles was incorrect.
Others: Some minor UI adjustments.

 Optimization: Settlement interface optimization

 Fix: Some skill attribute values were displayed as 0

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.1.0 Update Notes - June 15, 2025


We apologize for the wait. Initially, we only planned to add a costume change feature, but additional ideas emerged, which took extra time to implement.  


Update Details:


 Implemented a new UI system to enhance performance and optimize UI presentation.  
 Added a Clothing System for free mixing and matching of outfits. The original clothing replacement function has been removed; previous clothing sets can be viewed under [Girl Details] → [Clothing] → [Sets]. Clothing is obtained as level rewards, and styles drop from defeating bosses.  
 Introduced an Intimacy System with 10 levels in total. Increasing intimacy unlocks poses, actions, and special functions. Roses are awarded after completing levels and can be gifted to girls to raise intimacy.  
 Added action and pose displays.  
 Redesigned the level interface.  
 Optimized the Achievement interface with grouped display of achievements.  
 Added a display for item acquisition paths, with pop-up prompts when items are insufficient.  
 Enhanced the quality of girls' photo shoots, improved clarity, replaced and added new images. Each girl now has 14 photos. The photo viewing interface has also been optimized, and the order of photos in achievement rewards has been adjusted.  
 Added achievements related to clothing collection.  
 The [Reinforcement] interface has been redesigned and renamed [Enhancement].  
 Roses can be claimed as update compensation, and clothing styles are randomly unlocked based on the number of bosses defeated.  
 Added automatic upgrading during battles.  
 Other optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.0.1 Update Notes December 11, 2024



 Fixed the issue that girls could not be upgraded, and optimized the sound playback when leveling up.
 Fixed the issue that the leaderboard data was not uploaded, it seems that it is not displayed due to server latency, and I will continue to pay attention.
 Fixed an issue that dropped items were displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: v1.0.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.0.0 Update Notes December 9, 2024


 The game engine has been upgraded, and both the battle scenes and the character display effects have been improved to some extent.
 Steam achievements, statistics, and leaderboards have been added.
 One more set of costumes has been added for Sally and Rera respectively. You can obtain them by clearing the 10th level of the airport and the railway station. If you have already completed the levels, you can directly claim them after entering the game.
 When viewing characters, hold down the right mouse button and drag to move the view up and down.
 The difficulty of the achievement for [Remaining Health When Winning] has been reduced, and the bug that made it impossible to complete this achievement has been fixed.
 A novice level has been added.
 The game name has been changed. This has led to a change in the save file location. If the save files were not uploaded before the update, please manually copy the save files to the new directory.
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Game Marix/The Final Hunter/0_user_data ==> %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Game Marix/Final Hunter/
 Some other minor optimizations. 


Next, I will try to implement a costume change system. Therefore, only two sets of costumes have been added this time. If everything goes smoothly, it is expected that this work will be completed in January.
